summary: Together (af0ecbf9, two passes: fix-first, then lows-only at 70dcca7, the tree this commit applies) and the Settings leftovers (a8ce3c17, lows-only). Open lows: the 'You were just in' record is written under the browser's remembered profile and read under the acting one; the code field takes focus back unconditionally after a refused join; a room's Join button goes on reload without focus restored; Settings: a save judged before its list read goes on after an overtaking reload (a switch onto that profile in another tab skips the limit-yourself question); an overtaken reload waits for the newer one with no deadline; .stage-btn-wrap lacks overflow-wrap.
